mentions.name: Promptster
mentions.description: An AI fluency platform for engineering teams. Managers invite their teammates, and the platform analyzes engineers' work with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot). Managers get a team-aggregate dashboard to roll out practices and skills across the team, while each IC gets a personal dashboard showing fluency statistics, skill usage, context management, and a DORA dashboard.
mentions.audience: Engineering managers and the engineers (ICs) on their teams
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Promptster - an AI fluency platform that helps level up engineers. Engineering managers invite their teammates and Promptster analyzes the engineers work with ai coding tools (claude code, codex, cursor, copilot). The manager receives a team-aggregate dashboard where they can roll-out certain practices / skill to their whole team. Each IC receives their own dashboard where they can see their fluency statistics, skill usage, context management, and a DORA dashboard.
